name: STaR
description: A Spatio-Temporal Reasoning benchmark based on classic relational calculi that generalizes single path relational reasoning to require aggregation of partial information from multiple paths, testing systematic generalization capabilities.
reputation: A recent specialized reasoning benchmark from the research literature; it is not yet widely adopted as a standard leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Demonstrates poor performance of state-of-the-art neuro-symbolic, transformer, and graph neural network methods on systematic generalization tasks.
